description: Lot DA3 (ADR 0060) : langage unique des marqueurs de lieux sur la carte de campagne. Forme = type (pictogramme peint de l'atlas), écu = détenteur (armoiries de la faction), taille = rang. Règles de rang et de dé-encombrement par distance caméra.

pictograms.label: Capitale
pictograms.subject: a royal capital city seen from the front: a tall double ring of crenellated stone walls with many round towers topped by slate-blue conical roofs, a great Gothic cathedral with two towers and a royal palace keep rising above the roofs, a small gilded crown finial on the highest tower

pictograms.label: Grande cité
pictograms.subject: a great walled medieval city seen from the front: crenellated stone walls with several round towers and a gatehouse, crowded red and grey tiled roofs, a large Gothic cathedral with a tall spire rising in the middle

pictograms.label: Cité
pictograms.subject: a walled medieval cathedral city seen from the front: a ring of crenellated stone walls with four round towers and a gate, tiled roofs inside, one Gothic church with a spire rising above

pictograms.label: Ville close
pictograms.subject: a small walled market town seen from the front: a low crenellated stone wall with two small towers and a gate, a few timber-framed houses with red-brown tiled roofs and a parish church bell tower

pictograms.label: Ville
pictograms.subject: a small open market town seen from the front: a cluster of half-timbered houses with steep brown tiled roofs around a stone parish church with a square bell tower, a wooden palisade on one side

pictograms.label: Bourg
pictograms.subject: a tiny village seen from the front: three thatched cottages and a small stone chapel with a bell-cote, one tree

pictograms.label: Forteresse
pictograms.subject: a mighty medieval fortress on a rocky mound seen from the front: a massive square keep, a curtain wall with four big round towers with conical slate roofs, a twin-towered gatehouse

pictograms.label: Château
pictograms.subject: a stone medieval castle on a low mound seen from the front: a square crenellated keep with a small turret, a short curtain wall with two round towers

pictograms.label: Tour
pictograms.subject: a single fortified stone tower house (donjon) on a small grassy motte seen from the front, crenellated top, one small wooden hoarding

pictograms.label: Grande abbaye
pictograms.subject: a great Benedictine abbey seen from the front: a large Romanesque-Gothic abbey church with a tall crossing tower and a western bell tower, cloister buildings and an enclosure wall

pictograms.label: Abbaye
pictograms.subject: a small monastery priory seen from the front: a stone church with a small bell tower topped by a cross, a low cloister range with a red tiled roof

pictograms.label: Port
pictograms.subject: a single small 14th-century cog seen from the side: a high round-bellied clinker-built hull with a straight stem and sternpost, a small crenellated aftercastle, one mast with a single square sail, riding on stylised curling waves
